newsitem.title: USA: IntraNet says to acquire graphics firm.
newsitem.headline: IntraNet says to acquire graphics firm.

text.p: IntraNet Solutions Inc said on Friday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire a privately held custom printing and graphic communications business for about $1.8 million in cash, IntraNet stock and liability assumption.
The unnamed business is located in the southwestern United States and had revenues of about $3 million in its most recent fiscal year and a history of operating profits, IntraNet said.

IntraNet said it is in negotiations with the company to be acquired on the specifics of a definitive agreement. "When, and if, those negotiations are completed to the satisfaction of both parties, further specifics of the transaction will be made public," the company said.
IntraNet also said its registration statement for the sale of 680,746 shares of common stock has been declared effective by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
IntraNet, based here, sells information systems.
